text:
emma: Kicking off NebulaEdge alpha preview. High level: countersigned NDA, bench harness + telemetry schema, and a marketplace metadata stub. Need owners and short timeline.
raj: I picked up the NDA review. NebulaEdge sent Nebula_Redwood_Alpha_NDA_2026.pdf. They want ability to cite anonymized perf numbers in partner materials. I've asked legal to propose language.
claire: I'll put together the bench harness. Plan: perf sweep (seq 512/1024/2048), stability 6h, and quant comparison (fp16 vs q4_0). Will tag runs with partner:NebulaEdge and preview:alpha.
ops-bot: Reminder: lab access requires NDA countersign + eng-infra ticket. Use template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/CreateIssue?project=PART
tom: Ops can provision 2 x Nebula-E8 nodes for the dry-run. Need an approved run_id and the NDA attached to the ticket. Please don't schedule until legal confirms.
emma: Legal gating is fine. Raj, paste any unusual NDA clauses here so we can triage.
raj: Clause flagged: joint-data-use (section 5) says "mutual, non-exclusive usage of aggregated benchmarking results". Also a short embargo window request (72 hours) after mutual sign-off.
legal-bot: @raj Recommend amendment: "Redwood and NebulaEdge may use aggregated, anonymized benchmark metrics for marketing after mutual sign-off; raw traces are only shared under a short-lived debug token and deleted after 90 days. Embargo window: 72 hours post-sign-off."
claire: Harness prototype (linux container):
```
./nebbench --model rwd-13b-qat --seq 1024 --batch 8 --iters 600 \
  --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood.internal/v1/collect \
  --tags partner:NebulaEdge,slot:alpha \
  --flags --anon-aggregates-only
```
claire: Telemetry keys we'll emit: ["run_id","model","variant","seq_len","batch_size","tokens_per_sec","p50_ms","p95_ms","p99_ms","vram_pct","gpu_temp_c","partner_project"]. run_id must be UUID.
tom: Ops pre-check: NDA countersigned, run_id, harness flag --anon-aggregates-only set, badge access for partner observers. Dry-run slot tentatively Wed 09:00-12:00.
emma: Marketing hold: don't share numbers publicly until checklist cleared. I'll own the co-marketing approvals + joint blog draft.
raj: Suggested legal tweak accepted by me: add explicit review rights for any co-branded slides. Sophia, can you confirm?
legal-bot: @raj Confirmed in legal thread; please attach countersigned NDA to #legal-partnerships and tag @sophia when ready.
claire: Sample aggregated payload (compact): {"run_id":"uuid-9876","partner":"NebulaEdge-alpha","model":"rwd-13b-qat","seq":1024,"batch":8,"tokens_per_sec":1187.6,"p95_ms":26.3,"vram_pct":71}

emma: Timeline: if countersign by EOD today, run Wed dry-run and internal demo Fri. If not, shift everything +48h.
tom: I'll provision nodes once ticket created. Ops note: ensure --anon-aggregates-only is enforced by infra gating so raw traces can't be uploaded accidentally.
claire: Adding --si-debug-token that only enables raw trace upload to a signed URL for 7 days (requires legal + eng approval). Default runs will keep it off.
raj: Looping in @sophia and ops. Also adding a suggested amendment text to drive: https://drive.redwood.internal/d/nebula-alpha-amend.json
emma: Great work. Next sync Thu 10:00 to confirm countersign and runbook. If countersign arrives earlier I'll post an update here.
